reference_answer.response: The base jewelry-theft sublimit is $1,500 for this occurrence, shared by the unscheduled necklace and earrings. It sits within your $30,000 personal-property limit, not as an extra amount or $1,500 per item. The watch marketing sample is not an endorsement on this policy. The $1,500 figure is not a promised payment; I have not calculated a payout from the $2,400 estimate.
